scientific_integrity: Proof based on explicitly inverse incidence-witness maps and exact signed cubical presentation; finite Smith-normal-form computations are independent corroboration, not the all-case proof.
scientific_limitations: Only normalized Box-cubical degree-one integral homology is classified for finite hypergraphs with nonempty hyperedges and all vertices supported. No higher-degree or hypergraph-homotopy equivalence is inferred. Unindexed prior equivalents cannot be ruled out.
title: Incidence-transpose invariance of first cubical hypergraph homology
